name: Claude Quota Resume
description: Queues original prompts after Claude subscription quota errors and schedules retries at detected reset times.

initialRetryMs.description: First fallback retry delay when no reset time is reported (doubles per attempt, max 1 hour). Default 300000.

maxAttempts.description: Quota retries before an item goes to manual review. Default 50.

retryOnUnknownFailure.description: Deprecated and ignored: non-quota failures always go to manual review.
